Product: Microfiber hair drying towel turban for frizz reduction and water absorption in hair care.
Customer: Adults with curly, wavy, or thick hair; specifically noted for users with long hair.
Experience: Users report a soft, lightweight, and plush texture that is more comfortable and less bulky than heavy bath towels. It features a button for security and includes an extra button. While effective at absorbing water and preventing dripping, some users with very long hair found the size insufficient to contain all hair.
Context: Post-wash hair drying routine; used as a lightweight alternative to traditional towels to minimize heat damage and frizz.

Product: 21-color eyeshadow palette featuring 6 matte and 15 shimmer/metallic shades in neutral, orange, and purple tones.
Customer: Makeup artists (MUA/MUE), people of color (WOC), and budget-conscious users seeking a high-pigment alternative to expensive palettes.
Experience: Highly pigmented, creamy, and blendable textures. Users report long-lasting wear without creasing, especially when used with primer. However, some shades experience significant fallout or may crumble/smash easily if handled roughly.
Context: Versatile for creating subtle or bold multi-colored looks; suitable for daily routines, professional use, or as a gift. Often used alongside setting spray or eye primer to enhance longevity and minimize fallout.

Product: Waterproof mascara for eyes, designed to provide bold volume, length, and a very black finish.
Customer: Users with sensitive skin or dry eyes/contact lens wearers.
Experience: Features a creamy, whipped formula that leaves lashes feeling soft and separated. While marketed as waterproof, reviews vary on smudge resistance; some find it easy to remove, while others find it requires scrubbing with oil-based removers. One user reported clumping due to a missing tube insert.
Context: Suitable for daily eye makeup routines; can be layered for increased density.

Product: Maybelline City Bronzer, a multi-use powder for bronzing and contouring in the face makeup category.
Customer: Individuals with fair, porcelain, tan, or deep skin tones; noted for use on oily skin.
Experience: A smooth, buildable, and micro-milled matte powder that applies evenly without patchiness and offers long-lasting wear. While most users report a non-sparkly, velvety finish, one user noted noticeable glitter. Some users found specific shades (e.g., 100, 200) too subtle or unexpectedly light, and one user found the color slightly too warm for fair skin.
Context: Daily makeup routines, including quick "out the door" looks, and use as eyeshadow.

Product: Adjustable metal tripod wig stand for styling, braiding, and wig making within the hair extensions and accessories category.

Customer: Wig makers and cosmetology students or professionals.

Experience: Users report a sturdy, well-constructed, and lightweight design that is easy to set up and adjust. The 360° rotation and height adjustability are highlighted as functional benefits. It includes a convenient carrying bag for portability and a separate table stand option. While one user noted a bent knob, they found it non-problematic.

Context: Ideal for daily hair styling, training, and professional cosmetology use. Its portability makes it suitable for travel or use at different heights (standing or seated).

Product: 12% Ammonium Lactate cream, a medicated moisturizer for treating dry, scaly skin conditions like ichthyosis vulgaris, keratosis pilaris, and xerosis.

Customer: Individuals with dry, scaly, bumpy, or cracked skin, including those with hereditary conditions, sun-damaged skin, or rosacea.

Experience: An intense moisturizer that effectively breaks down dead skin cells and exfoliates. Users report success with rough patches, "chicken skin," and cracked heels. While most find it highly effective, one user noted a bad odor. It is fragrance-free.

Context: Used in daily routines (often twice daily) for long-term management of skin conditions; can be applied to face, arms, legs, or feet. Often used as an alternative to prescription-strength versions.

Product: Deep cleansing cream cleanser for face.
Customer: Adults with normal skin; used by long-term users ranging from teenagers to seniors.
Experience: Users report a soothing, reliable, and effective cleanser/moisturizer that removes makeup. While many find the original scent nostalgic, some note a lighter texture and a strong clove scent in newer versions. There are significant complaints regarding inconsistent quality, specifically reports of the product arriving watered down, half-empty, or spilled.
Context: Daily skincare routine; suitable for home use or travel due to various sizes; used as a budget-friendly staple for families.

Product: Builder gel in a bottle for nail strengthening, repairs, and extensions within the nail art and polish category.

Customer: Adults, including beginners, DIY enthusiasts, and professionals; ideal for those with weak or damaged natural nails transitioning from acrylics.

Experience: A thick, self-leveling gel that is easy to control like polish. It provides a clear, shiny finish without yellowing. While effective for reinforcement and repairs (with or without silk/fiberglass), it is softer than acrylic or hard gel and not solvent-resistant. Users note it is easy to use, though some beginners may require practice.

Context: Daily nail care routines, salon-style DIY manicures, and strengthening natural nails or maintaining extensions.

Product: Vitamin C and Squalane facial oil for brightening, evening skin tone, and moisturizing.
Customer: Suitable for all skin types; used by individuals seeking to address wrinkles, redness, or hydration needs.
Experience: Reviews are divided on texture; some report a soft, velvety, quick-absorbing finish that provides a dewy glow, while others find it extremely greasy and non-absorbent. It features a dropper bottle for easy application. Scent reports vary from unscented/non-irritating to refreshing.
Context: Designed for daily morning use in a skincare routine; can be used alone or mixed with other products. Often used alongside other Valjean Labs serums.

Product: Pore-minimizing facial toner for exfoliating and balancing the complexion.
Customer: Users with various skin types, including extremely sensitive, combination, oily, and dry skin; effective for those prone to breakouts.
Experience: A clear, liquid toner with conflicting reports on scent (ranging from unscented to a strong floral/soapy fragrance). It provides hydration and helps clear breakouts, though effectiveness on pore size is disputed. While some sensitive users report no stinging, others experienced light irritation. The heavy glass bottle is viewed as elegant and sustainable but difficult to control, leading to accidental over-pouring.
Context: Part of a nightly facial routine; applied to cleansed face and neck via palms, cotton balls, or rounds.

Product: Nail art stamping plates for gel nail polish designs.
Customer: Nail art enthusiasts and collectors looking for affordable, decorative stamping tools.
Experience: Users report high-quality, deep etching that allows for easy pick-up with clear stampers and the ability to layer colors. The plates feature double-sided designs (effectively four plates in two) with smooth, non-sharp edges. While most find the fine lines easy to use, one user noted difficulty transferring smaller, intricate designs to the stamping tool.

Product: No-wipe, glossy gel top coat for nail art, specifically used for applying chrome and holographic powders.
Customer: Adults, including professional nail technicians and DIY enthusiasts.
Experience: Provides extreme shine and a self-leveling application. It can be left slightly tacky to help pigments adhere, though some users report a rubbery feel or potential peeling if applied over certain regular gel top coats. Effectiveness for chrome/holographic powder is highly rated, though one user noted inconsistent coverage.

Product: Self-tanning kit including body and face lotions with application mitts for a natural, sun-kissed tan.
Customer: Users of all skin types (oily, dry, combination, normal), including those seeking organic/non-toxic alternatives or safe options during pregnancy.
Experience: Provides an even, streak-free, and natural-looking color that lasts several days. Users report a white lotion that develops overnight. Scent reviews vary from "very pleasant" to "chalky." While generally non-staining and easy to correct, some users noted potential breakouts on the face or difficulty avoiding pigment in finger/toe webs.
Context: Ideal for weekly maintenance or building color; best used after exfoliating and moisturizing extremities; suitable for seasonal use to mask pale skin.

Product: Tropical mango-scented sugar scrub for exfoliating and hydrating dry skin within the body care category.

Customer: Individuals with dry skin seeking intense exfoliation and nourishment.

Experience: Users report a pleasant tropical scent and effective exfoliation that leaves skin feeling smooth and silky. While most find the texture thick and high-quality, one user noted a watered-down consistency. Packaging concerns exist regarding inconsistent seals (some arriving unsealed) and the presence of polyethylene microbeads, which some users find environmentally harmful.

Context: Part of a daily or regular body care routine for moisturizing and smoothing skin.

Product: Hydrogel sheet face mask for deep hydration and moisturizing dry skin.
Customer: Individuals with dry, sensitive, or eczema/psoriasis-prone skin.
Experience: A cooling, non-greasy, unscented gel texture that contours to the face. Some users report receiving only a single mask despite expectations of a multi-pack.

Product: Clear glass dappen dishes for mixing acrylic liquids and powders in nail art and manicure care.
Customer: Professional nail technicians and home users performing manicures on natural or false nails.
Experience: Users report the dishes are extremely small (smaller than a shot glass), making them difficult to use with standard acrylic brushes without tipping. While some find the glass quality as pictured, others reported receiving items that were chipped, cracked, or poorly packaged with visible glue residue.
Context: Used for mixing nail art materials during professional salon services or home nail care routines.

Product: High-pigment, soak-off UV/LED gel nail polish for manicures.

Product: Reusable, ultra-fine makeup remover cloths (set of 3) designed to remove foundation, waterproof makeup, and masks using only water.
Customer: Suitable for all skin types (oily, combination, dry, normal).

One user noted they can be used dry to target eyeshadow without disturbing foundation.
Context: Ideal for daily makeup removal routines, cleaning makeup brushes, and as a sustainable, cost-effective alternative to disposable makeup wipes.

Product: Self-fanning eyelash extensions for creating volume and mega volume lash sets.
Customer: Professional stylists and beginners looking to reduce application time or create handmade fans.
Experience: Highly effective and easy to fan with minimal pressure; users report a lightweight, soft, and natural feel. The lashes are dark, high-quality, and available in long lengths (up to 18mm). Packaging is noted as great.
Context: Professional salon use; ideal for daily volume or dramatic mega-volume lash applications; suitable for beginner kits to streamline the fanning process.

Product: Concentrated, all-purpose liquid Castile soap (Sweet Orange) for cleansing skin and hair.
Customer: Individuals with sensitive, oily, combination, or dry skin; suitable for babies and those seeking vegan, palm-oil-free, or natural formulations.
Experience: Users report superior lathering and a pleasant scent compared to competitors. It is highly concentrated, requiring significantly less product per use, and leaves skin feeling clean and moisturized without drying. Packaging is noted as leak-proof.
Context: Versatile use in daily routines as hand soap, body wash, or shampoo; also used as a base for DIY beauty products (e.g., coconut milk shampoo) and for laundry spot treatments.

Context: Used in warm baths, as a DIY magnesium oil spray, or as a topical skin/hair treatment; often integrated into nightly routines for stress relief and better sleep.

Product: 45-piece velvet hair scrunchie set for hair styling and accessories.
Customer: Users with all hair types, including medium-thickness wavy/curly hair.
Experience: Highly rated for value and quality, offering a significant upgrade from budget alternatives. The velvet material is extremely soft, and the elastics provide a firm hold. Colors are noted as vibrant and beautiful.
Context: Suitable for daily wear, parties, ceremonies, and DIY hairstyles; ideal for those seeking a large quantity of accessories at an affordable price.

Product: 6-in-1 microneedling derma roller kit for skin resurfacing, targeting acne scarring, wrinkles, stretch marks, and cellulite.
Customer: Men and women seeking topical absorption enhancement or skin texture improvement.

Product: Professional-grade hair dryer for frizz reduction and styling within the hair care category.

Product: 1.25-inch titanium ceramic flat iron for smoothing, straightening, and frizz reduction in hair care.

Product: Super smooth body lotion for moisturizing skin, featuring a peppermint and coconut scent.

Product: Gel-cream facial cleanser designed to remove dirt, oil, and makeup while addressing acne and blemishes.

Product: Strong hold, non-aerosol hair spray for texture and flexible hold in the hair care category.

Product: Shampoo and conditioner duo designed to protect against breakage and promote hair strength/health within the hair care category.

Product: Ice roller facial massager for puffiness, redness, and inflammation relief.

Product: 14-inch Remy human hair clip-in extensions for adding length and volume to hair.

Product: A thick, leave-in hydrating hair butter and styling cream designed for frizz control and curl definition.

Product: Liquid makeup remover for face and eyes within the makeup removal category.

Product: Jasmine hydrosol facial toner and scalp mist for skin balancing and hair moisture.
